items.text: Round 3 decisions incorporated into plan.md: (R3-d1) Test helper organization uses hybrid approach — shared test_helpers_test.go for cross-cutting utilities plus per-domain helper files co-located with tests. (R3-d2) Scope expanded to split the top 5 largest non-client/non-test files (main.go, git_runner.go, diff_service.go, visual_capture_storage.go, agent_manager_model.go) as new Phase 5. This overrides R2-d2's limited scope. (R3-d3) Sequential execution with metrics checkpoints after Phase 1 and Phase 2 for early validation.

Phase 5 (file splitting) added to the implementation strategy with concrete splitting strategies per file, constraints (same package, no import cycles), and per-file verification steps. The rollout checklist now includes Phase 5 and both mid-point metrics checkpoints. Risk table updated with R6 (import cycles from splits) and R7 (navigability after splits).

All 11 settled decisions from rounds 1-3 are documented in the plan's Settled Decisions table. R2-d2 is marked as overridden by R3-d2. The file inventory table now annotates each file's in-scope phase. The long_files <10 target is no longer best-effort — it is a hard target with Phase 5 providing the mechanism to achieve it.
All 5 readiness dimensions score 3/3. The plan passes validation with all 13 mandatory sections present. No remaining gaps — this item is ready for execution.

plan_updates: Incorporated R3-d1 (hybrid test helpers), R3-d2 (expanded scope with Phase 5 file splitting for top 5 largest files), and R3-d3 (metrics checkpoints after Phases 1 and 2). Updated scope section, file inventory annotations, settled decisions table, rollout checklist, and risk matrix. long_files <10 upgraded from best-effort to hard target.
